items.title: Sumner Labat Interview, 1962-11-11
items.q: I used to listen to, I believe it was the Imperial man with Manuel Réa and Pico. And then... Was Pico playing with us? He was playing the clarinet with Manuel Réa.

ctx.x: Last carnival we had Indians. I mean they had some beautiful costumes. Yeah, costumes but... Not like the New Orleans Indians, though. Oh, nothing. Oh no. They're wild. They go wild. Yeah, we got tame Indians. They're supposed to get juiced over their ass. I don't have two pistols in their bosom. One, two. That's true. I'm afraid of them. One of my favorite Indian tribes, the chief had one on each side. He made these suits. Of course, every night when you come from work, you wait an hour and a half, two hours on…

Mm-hmm. Well, I used to listen to, I believe it was the Imperial man with Manuel Réa and Pico. And then... Was Pico playing with us? He was playing the clarinet with Manuel Réa. They used to play at the old fros and I remember most of the time.
Late old NSH Ristar playing. That's right. And you were young then? Yeah.
